title: Verified discovery adopts once into native chat with scoped bridges and no replay
steps: Run the deterministic Node suites. They do not use user audio, send OTP, create sites or invoke providers.
expect: Anonymous and foreign-account adoption are refused; context and stable session mapping are owner/revision-bound.
A durable preparing mapping precedes native allocation; retries reuse the same ID without replaying prompts.
HTTP/WS mounts and API allowlists refuse unrelated paths; credentials never enter browser JSON.
Network/provider/quota tails remain manual; fresh speech is separate and retains native question behavior.
Parent handoff stops the legacy microphone and transfers only a manual draft.
The actual onboarding pre-step admits the imported record into the model decision and rejects missing receipts or another cwd.
fence: Verified identity, signed server allocation, encrypted CAS context, ordinary native permissions and method/path allowlists. Fixtures are not runtime acceptance.

tests: prepare is durable before native allocation; refresh does not duplicate sessions or prompts
failed or unsettled endings retain pending words without timer replay or question answers
